recommendations.title: Integrate 软件开发 into IFN711 Industry Project
recommendations.rationale: Software development is a high priority hard skill core to the occupation and strongly demanded by market evidence but is not observed in the current curriculum evidence. Since IFN711-demo focuses on team software development projects, integrating explicit learning outcomes and assessments on software development will directly address this gap, enhancing program relevance and graduate employability.
recommendations.suggested_change: Incorporate dedicated modules or learning tasks on software development methodologies and best practices within IFN711-demo, explicitly reflected in learning outcomes and project assessment criteria.

recommendations.title: Add 网络安全与隐私保护 coverage in IFN712 Research in IT Practice
recommendations.rationale: Domain-specific skill 网络安全与隐私保护 has high market demand and program relevance but is not observed in the current curriculum. IFN712-demo’s research focus makes it suitable for integrating current security and privacy topics in IT practice as a research subject to increase domain relevance.
recommendations.suggested_change: Augment IFN712-demo learning outcomes to include investigation and research on network security and privacy protection issues, supported by assessments like research reports and presentations.

recommendations.title: Strengthen and explicitly highlight 数据分析 skill in IFN712 Research in IT Practice
recommendations.rationale: Although the course IFN712-demo includes data analysis in its outcomes and has curriculum evidence, market demand for 数据分析 is high and not fully observed in curriculum evidence count, suggesting more explicit emphasis and deeper coverage would better align with market needs.
recommendations.suggested_change: Enhance the scope and depth of data analysis content and integrate assessments that require comprehensive data analysis and interpretation to align with industry standards.
limitations: Curriculum already includes some data analysis content; recommendation targets strengthening rather than new inclusion.

recommendations.title: Incorporate Algorithm Design & Optimization in IFN711 Industry Project
recommendations.rationale: Algorithm design and optimization is an occupation core skill with high priority and demand but currently not observed in the curriculum. Given IFN711-demo’s emphasis on software development projects, adding algorithmic problem solving and performance optimization learning outcomes will fill this critical skill gap.
recommendations.suggested_change: Include learning objectives and project criteria that require students to design, analyze, and optimize algorithms within software project tasks.

recommendations.title: Introduce 网络安全与隐私保护 optional module or activities in IFN711 Industry Project
recommendations.rationale: High market demand domain-specific skills such as 网络安全与隐私保护 can also be met by optional modules or project activities in practical courses to provide deeper specialization without disrupting core teaching.
recommendations.suggested_change: Offer an optional module or targeted project activities within IFN711-demo focusing on practical network security and privacy protection techniques.
limitations: Optional modules may have limited uptake; effectiveness depends on student interest.
